summary_markdown: The discussion focused on two urgent data deployments for Finland. First, a specific frequency formula (default * multiIf(dayNumber <= 1, 1.5, dayNumber <= 3, 4, dayNumber <= 5, 7, dayNumber <= 7, 10, dayNumber <= 31, 15, 20)) needed to be deployed from test to stage and production for specific companies (7863, 7864, 7865, 7905, 7906) and categories (City, Bus_Shelter). Second, a period setting needed to be moved from staging to production, covering the date range of October 1, 2024, through the present. Both tasks were confirmed as completed by [me].
decisions: The frequency formula was deployed to stage and production for specified companies/categories in Finland.
The period setting was successfully migrated from staging to production.
